name: Brass compass
role: Captain Livé’s separate navigation inventory prop
dimension_contract: Engine dimensions are authoritative. Set the reconstructed asset bounding dimensions to 0.09 m wide, 0.03 m tall and 0.09 m deep; source illustrations approximate those proportions and are not a metrically exact CAD model.

design.description: One shallow circular brass compass case sitting flat, with a broad bevelled upper rim, a horizontal seam, a lower cylindrical body and softly worn golden brass with brown patina. Its glass-covered dial faces vertically upward and sits flush inside the rim.
design.camera_visibility_note: The user requires level orthographic elevations with the optical axis at object mid-height. The upward-facing dial is edge-on and occluded by its rim in all four images. This sheet does not specify dial artwork or validate its reconstruction; do not invent an additional top or perspective panel.

generation_history.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: one inventory prop turnaround sheet, brass navigation compass for Captain Livé’s quarters, a cartoony 3D adventure game.

Inputs and their roles:
Image 1 (dark brown desk): MATERIAL / RENDERING STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match the chunky warm gold brass, broad sculpted highlights, slightly softened bevels, restrained broad scuffs, and cartoony dimensional rendering. Do not include the desk.
Image 2 (teal desk): EXISTING COMPASS DESIGN REFERENCE. Isolate the small shallow round brass compass sitting on its top. Preserve that simple circular brass casing, horizontal glass-covered dial, and squat proportions. Remove everything else. Disregard this reference camera completely.
Image 3 (Captain Livé): STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match the soft sculpted cartoony 3D material treatment; no character appears.

Create ONE coherent four-view sheet of that SAME compass, arranged left-to-right: FRONT, LEFT SIDE, RIGHT SIDE, BACK. These view names are instructions, DO NOT print labels. Model only the compass itself; no accompanying objects, no arrangement, no room.

CRITICAL CAMERA: Each is a true level ORTHOGRAPHIC ELEVATION. Camera optical axis perfectly horizontal through the middle of the compass height; camera pitch 0 degrees, roll 0 degrees. Rotate the object about its vertical axis by 0, 90, 270, and 180 degrees for the four elevations. No perspective, no three-quarter angle, no camera looking down. The horizontal upper glass dial is edge-on and hidden at this angle. DO NOT expose the dial face or draw a top ellipse to make it recognizable. Strict projection is more important than showing the dial. No extra top view.

SHAPE: exactly 0.09 m wide by 0.03 m tall by 0.09 m deep. A squat circular brass cylindrical compass case sitting flat, with a slightly thick upper brass rim and a smaller lower bevel. From all FOUR level directions its silhouette is a horizontal rounded rectangle measuring precisely THREE times wider than tall (3:1). Top and bottom edges horizontal and parallel, side edges vertical, very small rounded bevels only. A subtle horizontal seam near the top is part of the brass rim. The glass top sits flush inside the rim, so it cannot be seen at level. No lid, no ring, no chain, no handle, no stand, no feet, no crown knob, no hinge, no extra wooden case. Do not add studs or elaborate engraved ornament. Warm golden brass sidewalls with broad dark warm brown recesses and a few simple worn edge patches. Consistent geometry across all elevations.

LAYOUT: extremely wide landscape sheet around 3:1 aspect ratio, maximum native resolution. Four equally spaced columns, centered in each column. Each compass large enough to fill about 80% of its column width. All four objects EXACTLY identical pixel width and EXACTLY identical pixel height. Same orthographic zoom and no view-dependent scaling. Align all top edges to one common horizontal line and all bases to one common ground line. Leave wide complete vertical bands of pure white background between objects; nothing touches. Entire object visible with ample white outer margins. No drawn ground line. No contact shadows or cast shadows.

RENDERING: simple cartoony sculpted brass, softly rounded edges, broad warm gold highlight bands and rich brown sidewall shading. Saturated but worn colour. Consistent soft neutral studio lighting across views; no photographic microtexture, no photoreal reflections, no black ink outlines. Background perfectly flat opaque white RGB255,255,255, including every gap; no paper texture, gradient, floor, vignette or drop shadow. No text, letters, numbers, directional markings, captions, callouts, rulers, dimensions, watermarks, grid or borders anywhere.

assembly.command: python tools/crop_views.py <selected_raw_sheet> --names front left right back --row 0 1 --size 564 --out <temporary_crop_directory> --dry-run --preview art/props/compass/sheet.png
assembly.method: Repository cutter with default span filtering detects the four white-separated source views, places the original crops on equal native square canvases, aligns their bottoms, and writes the preview strip. No per-view resizing or repainting.

validation.method: Pixel foreground bounds measured against the modal background using the repository cutter tolerance 18 (sum of RGB distance > 54), followed by visual inspection. These checks cover the sheet, not a reconstructed mesh.

review.level_orthographic_elevations: Visually checked: no downward camera tilt, no exposed top dial and no three-quarter panels.
review.common_height: All four source and final foreground bounds have exactly the same measured pixel height.
review.isolation: Only the compass case is pictured; no separate props, labels or overlapping views.
review.remaining_proportion_deviation: The two middle silhouettes are slightly narrower than front/back: 2.2% total width spread. Width-to-height ratios are 2.799–2.862 rather than the target 3.0 (4.6–6.7% below target). Keep the explicit engine dimensions authoritative.
review.dial_reconstruction: Not validated: the required four level elevations do not expose the upward-facing dial.

pipeline.recommended_crop_command: python tools/crop_views.py art/props/compass/sheet.png --names front left right back --row 0 1 --size 1128 --out art/props/compass/views
pipeline.upscale_note: Native 564 px square cells can be enlarged uniformly to 1128 px for the documented minimum. Upscaling is not additional source detail. No upscaling was applied to sheet.png.
pipeline.lighting_note: Use reconstruction lighting removal and engine lighting to avoid doubling the soft form shading in the source.
